* Coordinate client inquiries, appointments, and care-related administrative tasks.

* Care Coordination and Scheduling

* create and maintain weekly caregiver schedules

* Match Caregivers with clients based on qualifications, availability, and client needs.

* Handle call-outs, missed shifts, late arrivals, and replacement coverage.

* Communicate schedule changes to clients, caregivers and authorized representative

* monitor scheduled, completed, missed, and cancelled visits.

* Track authorized service hours and notify management of discrepancies.

* Monitor authorization expiration dates and alert the appropriate staff.

* Communicate with clients and care teams by phone and other appropriate channels; route questions to the right person.

Marketing and Community Outreach

* Promote Royal Faith Homecare Agency's approved services to appropriate referral sources.

* Visit hospitals, rehabilitation facilities, medical offices, senior centers, veteran-serving organizations, and community organization.

* Build professional relationships with social workers, discharge planners, case managers, and other referral partners.

* Explain the agency Veteran, Private Pay homecare services and referral process accurately.

* Distribute approved brochures, business cards, and marketing materials.

* Assist with community events, networking meetings, and outreach campaigns.

Skills

* Medical office or general office experience; medical administrative support experience is helpful.

* Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) and EHR management, patient management software, and Microsoft Office.

* Knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance, and health regulation policies is preferred.

* Strong customer service, phone communication, and client communication skills.

* Accurate typing, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.

**Duties**

* Lead daily homecare operations, setting priorities and monitoring service quality, compliance, and operational performance.
* Direct managers and teams, building accountability through clear managerial communication, team leadership, and executive leadership.
* Partner with medical and nursing leaders on care delivery, staffing, and medical management.
* Lead Performance Improvement (PI) initiatives and collaborate cross-functionally to address operational challenges and support strategic goals.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience in healthcare management, operations management, and operational management, including leadership of teams and managers.
* Nursing leadership experience and a background in medical leadership or medical management are important for guiding homecare services.
* Knowledge of health regulation policy and Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations (JCAHO) standards, with the ability to apply requirements to operations.
* Strong strategic management, executive leadership, team leadership, and managerial communication skills.
* Ability to manage healthcare finances and work effectively across clinical, administrative, and operational functions.

Pay: From $19.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oxford, AL 36203

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence, is a hands-on practitioner who supports ESCO sites in deploying the **ESCO Operating System (EOS)**. The person in this role travels to sites to facilitate Kaizen events, take part in key EOS activities, and coach site leaders and teams to strengthen EOS adoption, practice, and results.

Site Presidents and site EOS Managers own and lead EOS deployment at their sites. This role supports them as an experienced practitioner and member of a small central EOS team. The EOS Program Lead owns program strategy and the development of EOS elements, and a peer role owns data, tools, KPIs, and monthly business reviews. This role helps sites put EOS standards into practice on the floor and brings field learning back to improve those standards.

This is a director-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. It works through influence with site leaders and teams. The initial focus is the Aerospace & Defense group, with expansion to other ESCO divisions as EOS deployment grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Site Deployment Support***

* Support site Presidents and EOS Managers in executing their annual EOS deployment plans toward EOS maturity certifications.
* Participate in key EOS activities during site visits, such as MDI, Kaizen events, and Gemba Walks, and provide sites with direct feedback to enhance adoption and practice.
* Help sites put EOS elements into practice, including MDI, Gemba Walks, KPI management, action management, P&R, structured problem solving, and leader standard work.
* Provide sites with continued support to improve EOS adoption, sustainment, and results.

***Kaizen and Improvement Events***

* Plan and facilitate Kaizen events with site teams: scoping and chartering with site leadership, pre-event data collection, team training, current state analysis, implementation on the floor, report-out, and 30/60/90-day follow-up.
* Help sites build and manage their CI pipeline so events are selected based on business priorities, KPI gaps, and financial impact.
* Develop site Kaizen leaders and facilitators so sites can run events on their own and meet their annual Kaizen plan.
* Document event results and savings, and partner with site finance to validate benefits.

***Coaching and Capability Building***

* Deliver EOS training on site, from leadership sessions to hands-on floor training for supervisors and team members.
* Coach site leaders, supervisors, and EOS Managers on daily management, visual management, standard work, and problem solving.
* Support site EOS Managers in developing EOS champions and practitioners at their sites.

***Assessment, Tracking, and Feedback***

* Support EOS maturity assessments and certification readiness reviews, including site tours, interviews, and evidence review.
* Monitor deployment progress, action closure, and sustainment at supported sites, and report status to the EOS Program Lead.
* Help site leaders remove barriers, and raise issues to the EOS Program Lead when deployment is at risk.
* Bring field feedback into the EOS program: what works, what does not, and where process guides, tools, and training need to change.
* Share good practices across sites and connect site teams with each other.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* 8+ years of experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, Lean, or manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a hands-on deployment or practitioner role.
* Has personally facilitated 10 - 20 or more Kaizen events with documented results.
* Hands-on experience practicing and coaching tiered daily management (MDI or similar), Gemba Walks, visual management, standard work, and structured problem solving (A3, PDCA, root cause analysis).
* Experience in a company with a structured operating or business system strongly preferred. Must be a U.S. Person and able to provide appropriate documentation
* Experience supporting deployment across multiple sites preferred.
* Plant or operations leadership experience preferred. Credibility with site leaders and on the floor is essential.
* Aerospace, defense, industrial, or complex high-mix manufacturing experience preferred.
* Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Must be a U.S. Person with a valid US passport with the ability to travel internationally.

**Required Capabilities**

new_roles.title: Director of Facilities and Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Facilities & Operations serves as a key member of the leadership team and is responsible for the stewardship, maintenance, safety, and operational excellence of the retreat center’s older buildings, grounds, infrastructure, and support services. Guided by Franciscan values of simplicity, compassion, peace, and reverence for creation, this role ensures that the physical environment reflects a spirit of hospitality, beauty, and care for all who visit.

The Director oversees facilities maintenance, grounds management, capital improvement projects, compliance, vendor relationships, safety compliance, and operational support services. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader with experience in facilities management, construction, property management, or building operations who can balance strategic planning with day-to-day operational oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilities & Property Management**

· Provide leadership and oversight for the maintenance, repair, and improvement of all buildings, grounds, utilities, and infrastructure across the retreat center campus.

· Develop and implement preventative maintenance programs to ensure the longevity and reliability of facilities and equipment.

· Develop and maintain a multi-year facilities and building assessment plan with replacement forecast (roofs, HVAC, water/septic, electrical, roadways).

· Manage rural site systems including well, septic/on-site wastewater, water treatment, propane, backup power/generators, private roads, and irrigation, ensuring resilience to wildfire, storm, and extended-outage conditions.

· Coordinate and supervise facility improvement projects, renovations, and construction activities from planning through completion.

· Conduct regular inspections of buildings and grounds and establish priorities for repairs and upgrades.

· Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, health, environmental, and building regulations.

**Construction & Capital Projects**

· Manage capital improvement projects, including budgeting, contractor selection, scheduling, and quality control.

· Serve as the primary liaison with architects, engineers, contractors, inspectors, and vendors.

· Develop project scopes, obtain bids, review contracts, and monitor project progress.

· Maintain long-range facility and infrastructure improvement plans aligned with organizational priorities.

· Evaluate facility systems and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, sustainability, and guest experience.

**Operations Leadership**

· Oversee operational support functions including maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and facility readiness for retreats and events.

· Develop and implement operational procedures to ensure efficient, consistent, and safe facility operations.

· Coordinate logistics to support retreat programs, guest groups, and special events.

· Ensure facilities are prepared and functioning properly to support all scheduled activities.

**Team Leadership**

· Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and support staff.

· Foster a collaborative culture of accountability, stewardship, and service.

· Establish work schedules, assign priorities, and ensure effective staff coverage.

· Promote safe work practices and ongoing professional development.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

· Assist in the development and management of facility, operations, and capital budgets.

· Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.

· Solicit and evaluate vendor proposals and negotiate service agreements.

· Manage relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure quality work and cost-effective solutions.

**Guest & Retreat Experience**

· Ensure retreat guests experience a safe, clean, comfortable, and welcoming environment.

· Collaborate with retreat and program staff to align facility operations with guest and event needs.

· Address facility-related concerns promptly and professionally.

**Administrative Responsibilities**

· Maintain accurate records related to maintenance activities, inspections, projects, vendor contracts, and regulatory compliance.

· Prepare reports and recommendations regarding facility conditions, capital needs, and operational improvements.

· Support organizational initiatives and special events as requested.

**Qualifications Required**

· Minimum of 2 years of experience in facilities management, construction management, property management, building operations, or a related field.

· Demonstrated experience supervising maintenance personnel, contractors, or operational teams.

· Strong knowledge of building systems, preventative maintenance practices, safety procedures, and facility operations.

· Proven project management skills, including budgeting, scheduling, and contractor oversight.

· Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

· Ability to prioritize multiple projects and respond effectively to operational needs.

**Preferred**

· Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

· Experience in hospitality, retreat centers, camp and conference centers, educational campuses, nonprofit organizations, or mission-driven environments.

· Background in commercial construction, renovation projects, or capital improvement management with knowledge of older infrastructure.

· Knowledge of and/or desire to learn water system operation.

· CPR/First Aid certification.

**Work Environment**

· Requires regular physical presence throughout the retreat center campus.

· Frequent walking across buildings and grounds, including uneven outdoor terrain.

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform occasional physical inspections of facilities and equipment.

· Availability for occasional evenings, weekends, and emergency response situations as operational needs require.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

existing_roles.title: Director, Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Documents and maintains the company's Quality Management System and verifies its compliance to ISO/TL standards.

2. Documents and maintains the company’s Environmental Management System and verifies its compliance to ISO 14001 standards.

3. Updates documentation as changes are made (procedures, quality and environmental manuals, work instructions, and forms).

4. Maintains quality and environmental records (including, but not limited to Corrective Actions, Audit Results, Employee Training Records, and Document Control Logs).

5. Plans and conducts Management Review Meetings.

6. Performs annual internal audits to determine continuing compliance to ISO standards, as necessary.

7. Works with outside parties (suppliers, customers, and ISO Registrar) on all Quality and Environmental System-related issues.

8. Manage, train, and develop the Quality Department team

9. Responsible for providing employees with ISO training.

**Skills Needed**

* + Strong Reasoning and Critical Thinking Skills (Sound Judgement)
* + High Impact Decision Making (Face Paced Environment)
* + Diplomacy in Difficult Situations
* + Attentive to Detail
* + Strong Presentation Skills & Communication (verbal and non-verbal)
* + Customer/Employee Relations Skills
* + Strong Data Analysis Skills
* + Team Management Skills (Ability to drive staff to action and get results through others)
* + Flexible to Change
* + Strong Organization Skills

  

**Minimum Educational Requirements**

Minimum High School Diploma or GED Required.

A college degree in Business Management or related field is preferred, but not required.

**Experience Required**

The successful candidate will have one to two years experience in Quality Management, ISO 9000 implementation, or a related field.

**NOTE:**

The purpose of this outline job description is to focus attention on the most important aspects of the job. It is not intended to be a complete list of every duty and it is therefore to be expected that the day-to-day performance of the job will frequently include tasks not listed above.

The list of duties for which the job holder is responsible may be varied or added to at the discretion of your manager. Any such alterations intended to be permanent will be added to this job description.

#### **Experience**

Required

* TL 9000
* ISO 9001

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
Are you a quality leader who enjoys building systems, developing teams, and creating a culture of continuous improvement? Advantic Building Group is seeking a Director of Quality to lead enterprise-wide quality strategy, establish a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), drive ISO 9001 certification efforts, and partner with leaders across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the future of quality within a growing organization.

At Advantic Building Group, we design, fabricate, and install innovative Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) structural systems that help our customers build smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

But what truly sets Advantic apart isn’t just what we build — it’s **how** we work and **who** we work with.

We're a team that values ownership, camaraderie, and curiosity. We roll up our sleeves, tackle challenges together, and support one another along the way. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a quality leader who shares those values and can help strengthen the culture we've built while establishing the systems, processes, and accountability necessary to deliver exceptional quality outcomes for our customers.

**Why Join Advantic?**

* Lead the development of a scalable enterprise-wide Quality Management System (QMS)
* Drive Advantic's ISO 9001 certification journey
* Influence quality across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations
* Build and develop a growing quality organization
* Partner directly with senior leadership to shape strategic initiatives
* Make a visible impact on customer success, operational excellence, and company growth

  

**Role Summary**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership for quality across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, assembly, and field operations. This role is responsible for developing and executing Advantic Building Group's quality strategy, building a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), leading ISO 9001 certification efforts, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This leader partners closely with operations, engineering, supply chain, and project teams to reduce defects, improve process performance, strengthen customer confidence, and support the company's growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership and Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute a quality roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational risks, and manufacturing and construction requirements; set annual objectives, priorities, and resource needs, including staffing, inspection equipment, and quality technology.
* Report quality performance, emerging risks, and cost of poor quality (scrap, rework, field repairs, returns, warranty) to senior leadership with clear owners, deadlines, and escalation expectations, and partner with Operations and Delivery to reduce it.

**Quality Management Systems (QMS) & ISO 9001 Leadership**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Advantic's Quality Management System (QMS), while leading ISO 9001 certification readiness, certification audits, surveillance audits, and recertification activities.
* Build a scalable, practical Quality Management System that enables operational consistency, supports growth, improves customer satisfaction, and achieves ISO 9001 certification.
* Govern document, configuration, and revision control across engineering drawings, submittals, production information, and field documentation, and ensure quality records are reliable and accessible across ERP, MES, and document systems with defined data ownership.

**Manufacturing Quality, Process Control & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, and release controls for incoming materials, in-process fabrication, final assembly, packaging, and pre-shipment verification, ensuring products conform to approved drawings, engineering requirements, customer specifications, and applicable contractual and industry requirements.
* Partner with Operations on specification review, design reviews, process risk assessments, first-build validation, and readiness for new or changed products and processes; coordinate qualified technical resources when specialized expertise is needed.
* Define traceability, inspection records, measuring equipment controls, calibration, and measurement method validation appropriate to risk and application.
* Establish controls for FRP materials and structural assemblies, including storage, handling, fabrication, and special processes.

**Corrective Actions, Root Cause Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Lead the enterprise nonconformance and corrective action process, including containment, material disposition, root cause analysis, escalation management, and verification of corrective action effectiveness across internal, supplier, customer, and field-related issues.
* Exercise authority under approved procedures to quarantine material, hold shipments, or stop affected work when conformity is in question; coordinate technical dispositions and obtain required customer approval for concessions or deviations, while maintaining independence of quality decisions.

**Supplier, Subcontractor, & Field Quality Management**

* Partner with Supply Chain to establish supplier qualification, approval, audit, and performance monitoring, including quality requirements for outsourced services and subcontracted work, and maintain approval status in the approved supplier system.
* Ensure certifications, traceability, inspection evidence, and customer requirements are flowed down to suppliers and verified.
* Lead supplier corrective actions and improvement plans, and support cost recovery within established commercial authority.
* Develop the field quality program for construction management and data center white space work, including project quality plan templates, inspection and test plan requirements, hold and witness points, and documentation standards that on-site QC managers must follow.
* Set expectations for, train, and hold on-site QC managers accountable to the program through project kickoffs, periodic field audits, and review of inspection records, field non-conformances, and punch list and turnover documentation.
* Serve as the escalation point for field quality issues and the senior quality contact for customers and third-party inspectors during audits and handover.

  

**Performance Measures**

* Establish baselines, targets, and reporting definitions with leadership. Measures include first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, nonconformance recurrence and closure time, corrective action effectiveness, supplier performance, customer complaints, field deficiencies, audit completion, calibration compliance, and progress against the quality roadmap.

  

**People Leadership and Shared Accountability**

* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and development of quality personnel, with training matrices, competency expectations, and succession plans.
* Partner with operational leaders to build quality awareness across the organization, and hold process owners accountable through agreed governance and escalation, reinforcing that each department owns the quality of its work.
* Model Ownership, Camaraderie, and Curiosity through clear expectations, respectful challenge, and consistent follow-through.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive quality experience, including five or more years leading a quality team or function in manufacturing or a comparable technical environment.
* Demonstrated success building, implementing, or significantly improving Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Experience leading ISO 9001 implementation, certification readiness, and managing internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Proven results developing people, leading change across departments, and reducing defects, repeat failures, or quality-related costs.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and inspection requirements; practical knowledge of measurement systems, traceability, process controls, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience using ERP, MES, electronic quality systems, or comparable tools to establish dependable workflows and actionable reporting.
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers, frontline employees, and senior leaders; make sound decisions under pressure; and resolve competing quality, schedule, and business priorities.

  

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with FRP or composite products, structural fabrication, engineered assemblies, construction quality, or mission-critical and data center projects.
* Experience connecting manufacturing quality with field installation, subcontractor oversight, customer acceptance, and project turnover.
* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or CQA certification; ISO 9001 lead auditor qualification; or Lean Six Sigma training with demonstrated application.

  

**Physical demands**

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to communicate effectively through speaking and listening. The role typically involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move objects up to 15 pounds.

*Advantic Building Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality and Compliance
existing_roles.description:
Founded in 1982 as Joliet Area Community Hospice, Lightways Hospice and Serious Illness Care is an independent, nonprofit healthcare provider licensed in 11 counties in northwest Illinois. We provide exceptional serious illness care, hospice care and grief support for adults and children.

The majority of our direct patient care is in the field with Lightways team members providing care in the home, nursing facility or assisted living facility. We also have a 24-bed inpatient unit in Joliet. Non-clinical staff are based out of our Joliet administrative offices.

**Director of Quality and Compliance**

The Director of Quality & Compliance provides administrative oversight for Quality, Compliance, Medical Records, and Risk Management functions, while also serving as the organization’s designated Compliance Officer.

This role delivers strategic and operational leadership for the Lightways Quality Assessment & Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, regulatory compliance, accreditation readiness, clinical education, and risk management. The Director is responsible for developing, implementing, and evaluating robust systems that promote safety, regulatory adherence, and high-quality care across all organizational operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Reference, research, report, track, and monitor compliance and quality-related data.
* Develop, implement, and evaluate strategies for quality assurance, performance improvement, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Create and maintain the organization’s annual Quality and Compliance Plans and Reports.

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals (NPH) is dedicated to providing unparalleled service to our patients, team members, physicians, and families. With locations in Indiana, Michigan, Texas, Ohio, and Arizona, we are expanding access to our unique model of care across the United States. NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals is looking for a Director of Quality and Risk at our **Huber Heights, OH** location. existing_roles.description:
Position Title: Quality Manager

Reports To: Plant Manager

Position Summary

The Quality Manager is responsible for the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) and overall product quality performance. This role focuses on ensuring compliance with AS9100 requirements, driving corrective actions and maintaining consistent quality standards across all operations.

The primary focus of this role is ownership of the QMS, proactive quality leadership and ensuring quality standards are effectively executed in both production and administrative processes.

Project Prioritization & Scope

· Ensure the Quality Management System is maintained, compliant and effectively implemented across the organization.

· Prioritize and drive corrective actions related to customer complaints, internal defects and supplier issues.

· Ensure timely completion of PPAPs, first article inspections and other customer-required quality deliverables.

· Balance time between production floor engagement and administrative quality responsibilities based on business needs.

· Proactively identify quality risks in production and implement containment and corrective actions.

· Prioritize improvement activities based on quality performance metrics, including customer returns, scrap and supplier performance.

· Coordinate with Production, Engineering and other departments to address quality-related risks and issues.

· Ensure nonconforming material is properly controlled, documented and dispositioned in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities

· Own and maintain the AS9100 Quality Management System, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.

· Lead internal audits and coordinate external audits, including customer and registrar audits.

· Monitor quality performance and address issues impacting product quality in real time.

· Communicate quality performance, risks and significant issues to leadership in a timely manner.

· Perform hands-on inspection of parts as needed to verify quality standards and reinforce expectations.

· Engage with production employees through brief training and coaching conversations to improve quality awareness and execution.

· Lead and drive corrective actions (8D, CARs, SCARs) across departments, ensuring timely completion and effectiveness.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for customer quality issues and responses.

· Oversee supplier performance, including quality, corrective actions and on-time delivery.

· Own, monitor and drive improvement of key quality performance metrics including customer returns, internal scrap and supplier performance.

· Support or perform technical validation activities such as dimensional inspection and laser scanning as required.

· Ensure inspection processes (incoming, in-process, final) are effective and consistently executed.

Implementation & Sustainment

· Ensure quality processes and standards are consistently followed and sustained across all departments.

· Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions and escalate when issues are not resolved.

· Verify that process changes, corrective actions and improvements are properly implemented and maintained.

· Ensure documentation and records within the QMS remain current, accurate and controlled.

Quality System & Process Execution Focus

· Oversee adherence to quality standards across all manufacturing processes.

· Monitor process compliance and identify deviations from established quality requirements.

· Ensure nonconforming material is clearly identified, segregated and controlled.

· Prevent shipment of nonconforming product through effective inspection and process controls.

Training & Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Provide training, coaching and guidance to employees regarding quality standards and expectations.

· Conduct brief, on-the-floor interactions to reinforce quality awareness and correct behaviors.

· Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance and other departments to resolve quality issues.

· Work with Purchasing and suppliers to address supplier-related quality concerns.

· Drive accountability for quality performance across all departments.

· Conduct regular team communication meetings and employee development discussions to support accountability, alignment and performance.

Role Scope & Responsibilities

The following clarifies the scope of this role in relation to other functions within the organization:

· This role owns the Quality Management System and is accountable for its effectiveness and compliance with AS9100 requirements.

· This role is responsible for proactively identifying, initiating and driving corrective actions across all departments.

· This role owns quality outcomes and is responsible for ensuring completion of quality-related activities, regardless of which function performs the work.

· This role is responsible for maintaining a consistent presence on the production floor to verify quality and reinforce standards.

· This role is expected to proactively identify, escalate and drive resolution of quality risks without requiring direction from others.

· This role supports production through quality oversight but does not own production output or scheduling.

· This role is responsible for driving accountability to quality standards across all departments and providing leadership, direction and oversight to quality personnel as organizational needs evolve.

· This role supports product validation activities such as PPAP and inspection but does not own process design, which is the responsibility of the Process Engineer.

· This role is accountable for ensuring nonconforming material processes are followed but relies on cross-functional support for execution of material movement and disposition actions.

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you okay with working in an office setting and on the production floor?

Experience:

* Quality management: 5 years (Required)
* Quality audits: 5 years (Required)

Location:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Vice President, Manufacturing**

Operations & Manufacturing

Chief Operating Officer

Secret (or eligible)

**ABOUT ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS COMPANY**

Advanced Technology Systems Company designs and builds mission-critical systems that protect U.S. warfighters, national infrastructure, and allied partners. Our solutions are fielded by the Department of War (DOW) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), as well as the most demanding military end users in the world, where performance, quality, and on-time delivery are non-negotiable. As our backlog of multi-million-dollar government programs grows, we are investing in the people, automation, and facilities needed to deliver at scale.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a proven Vice President of Manufacturing to lead end-to-end manufacturing and materials operations across our government and defense program portfolio. This executive will provide strategic and operational leadership for production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, and material-flow functions—including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations—and oversee the manufacturing planning and procurement systems that enable execution. The role owns plant operations, factory overhead, process automation, throughput, process controls, and facilities, turning contract commitments into high-quality hardware delivered on schedule and within cost. This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who has scaled defense production and integrated manufacturing, quality, and supply functions to support sustained growth. You will sit on the senior operations leadership team and have a direct impact on program margins, customer confidence, and the company’s growth.

**ORGANIZATIONAL SCOPE**

The position is intended to provide executive-level oversight of the integrated functions and capabilities required to plan, source, build, inspect, and deliver products. Functions within the role’s organizational scope are expected to include hourly assembly and test personnel; manufacturing engineering; quality; procurement; and materials operations, including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom management. The role also provides functional ownership and governance of the manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), in coordination with IT and Finance as appropriate.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Program Production Execution**

* **Contract delivery: Own manufacturing execution for multi-million-dollar DOW and government contracts, meeting cost, schedule, and quality requirements from LRIP through full-rate production.**
* Integrated planning: Lead integrated production and materials planning with Program Management, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain; align master production schedules, procurement plans, material availability, capacity plans, and Earned Value (EVMS) reporting.
* **Production readiness:** Lead design-for-manufacturability reviews, PRRs, and transition-to-production activities for new multi-million dollar programs.

**Plant Operations & Financial Performance**

* **Factory leadership:** Lead plant managers, production supervisors, manufacturing engineers, and hourly workforce across shifts; build a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Cost ownership:** Manage the manufacturing budget, labor, and factory overhead; drive cost-reduction initiatives that protect program margin and improve competitiveness on future bids.
* **Throughput:** Set and deliver targets for yield, cycle time, OEE, first-pass yield, and on-time delivery; remove bottlenecks and balance lines.

**Materials, Procurement & Quality**

**Procurement leadership:** Provide strategic oversight of procurement, supplier performance, sourcing, and material availability; align purchasing priorities with production schedules, program requirements, and cost objectives.

**Materials flow:** Oversee kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations to ensure accurate inventory control, timely material delivery to production, and effective control of work in process.

**Quality leadership:** Provide leadership and accountability for manufacturing quality, corrective and preventive action, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement; ensure quality is integrated into production planning and execution.

**Planning systems:** Own the business processes and functional requirements for manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems, including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing; drive data integrity, effective system utilization, and coordination with IT and Finance.

**Automation & Process Controls**

* **Automation strategy:** Define and execute a multi-year automation roadmap, including robotics, automated test, and MES/ERP integration, with clear ROI.
* Quality & process discipline: Lead the quality function and establish statistical process control, configuration management, corrective action, and documentation compliant with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, and customer quality clauses.
* **Lean & Six Sigma:** Deploy Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma practices to reduce variation, scrap, rework, and cost of poor quality.

**Facilities Management**

* **Facilities & capital:** Oversee facilities, maintenance, EHS, and secure-area requirements; lead capital planning, plant layout, and expansion projects to support backlog growth.
* **Compliance & audits:** Serve as the senior manufacturing representative for DCMA, customer, and third-party audits and source inspections.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership, including 7+ years at the director or VP level running plant operations for complex electromechanical, electronic, or aerospace hardware.
* Demonstrated record of scaling and automating production on large U.S. defense or military contracts, from low-rate initial production to full-rate output.
* Full P&L or cost-center accountability for factory operations, including labor, overhead, and capital budgets.
* Deep working knowledge of AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, CMMC, EVMS, and DCMA oversight.
* Hands-on experience implementing automation, robotics, MES, and data-driven process controls with measurable gains in throughput and quality.

Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing procurement, supplier performance, materials management, and production-support functions such as kitting, receiving, shipping, and inventory/storeroom operations.

Experience leading or optimizing manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (e.g., Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), including cross-functional process and data governance.

* Proven ability to lead and develop large, multi-shift teams, including union or hourly workforces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* U.S. citizenship with an active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA or Master’s degree in Engineering or Operations Management.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
* Experience standing up a new production facility or greenfield line, and with contract manufacturer and key supplier negotiations.
* Background with prime contractors or fast-growing defense technology companies (e.g., unmanned systems, counter-UAS, C4ISR, or missile systems).

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* All active production programs deliver on schedule, with a clear plan to close any cost or schedule gaps.
* A funded, phased automation roadmap approved by leadership, with early wins in throughput and labor efficiency.
* Factory KPIs (OTD, FPY, OEE, cost per unit, safety) defined, visible, and trending up quarter over quarter.
* A strong leadership bench in place across production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, materials operations, and facilities.
* Facilities and capacity plan aligned to the company’s three-year backlog and growth targets.

Production schedules supported by reliable material planning, supplier performance, inventory accuracy, and effective use of Costpoint MRP/Purchasing or applicable enterprise systems.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Mission:** Build the systems that protect U.S. service members and critical infrastructure.
* **Impact:** Shape a modern, automated factory and the operating model behind it, with the executive authority and investment to do it.
* **Growth:** Join a growing defense technology company with an expanding backlog of funded programs.
* **Rewards:** Competitive executive compensation, performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits.

*To conform to U.S. Government export regulations (ITAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Advanced Technology Systems Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Kentucky Trailer

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Job Title: Director of Operations
  
Division: Kentucky Trailer  
Location: Louisville, KY- 3 site locations  
Reports to: President, Kentucky Trailer  
FLSA: Exempt  
  
This position has multiple direct reports across 3 sites. Current direct reports include Operations Manager, 7 Team Leaders, and a Manufacturing Engineer/Facilities Manager. This position requires local travel between the 3 sites in Louisville.  
  
Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. Most of what we build is engineered to order rather than off the shelf, which makes our operations both challenging and rewarding to lead.  
  
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. The role owns the manufacturing operating budget, develops frontline leaders, and builds a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Works closely with Materials, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Commercial Sales to make sure production plans are executable and customer commitments are met. The workforce is non-union.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or another technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years in manufacturing with a proven record of success and increasing responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years leading multi-site operations through managers and leaders.
* Demonstrated record of improving safety performance
* Lean Manufacturing experience or certification, with measurable results in efficiency improvement and cost reduction.
* Demonstrated P&L or operating budget accountability.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
* Willingness to live and work in the greater Louisville, KY area.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Trailer, truck body or similar fabrication, welding and assembly experience.
* Experience in high-mix, custom build-to-order manufacturing.
* MBA or other financial education.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

This role works in both office and manufacturing plant settings, with exposure to noise, welding, painting and moving equipment. Required PPE must be worn on the production floor. The role regularly requires walking and standing for extended periods.

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

At **Miltope Corporation** we apply our technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives. For our latest news and to learn more, please visit us at www.mymiltope.com and follow us on our Miltope Corporation LinkedIn page (just look for our rugged Rhino)!

  

Miltope Corporation is seeking an experienced aerospace quality and regulatory compliance executive to lead the company's Quality organization and ensure continued compliance with applicable Department of War, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), and customer requirements.

  

This position has responsibility for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of the company's quality management systems supporting but not limited to:

  

* FAA Part 21 Production Approval operations.
* FAA Part 145 Certified Repair Station operations.
* EASA Part 145 Approved Maintenance Organization operations.
  

The Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance will serve as the senior independent authority for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality system effectiveness across production and repair station operations.

  

Reporting directly to the CEO/President, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Repair Station management to ensure that regulatory requirements are understood, implemented, monitored, and consistently maintained.

  

The successful candidate must possess the leadership capabilities to establish an effective quality culture while maintaining the technical knowledge and operational experience necessary to engage directly in regulatory matters, audits, investigations, and corrective action activities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality System Leadership**

  

* Maintain overall responsibility for the effectiveness and compliance of Miltope's quality management systems supporting FAA Part 21 Production Approval and FAA/EASA Part 145 Repair Station operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, and applicable EASA Part-145 requirements.
* Maintain and oversee the implementation of applicable Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.
* Ensure that regulatory requirements, approved procedures, and customer-specific quality requirements are effectively communicated and implemented throughout the organization.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on company operations, procedures, and approvals.
* Serve as the primary Quality organization representative in regulatory compliance matters and coordinate with designated Accountable Managers and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure that organizational responsibilities, delegated authorities, and quality reporting relationships are clearly defined and maintained.
  

**FAA and EASA Regulatory Oversight**

  

* Oversee the company's compliance with FAA Production Approval requirements, including organizational controls, production conformity, quality assurance, and product traceability.
* Oversee FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality control activities, ensuring compliance with the Repair Station Manual, Quality Control Manual, and applicable Operations Specifications.
* Ensure EASA Part-145 compliance monitoring requirements are effectively implemented and maintained.
* Ensure the designated EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager has the necessary independence, authority, resources, and organizational access to perform assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, surveillance activities, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.
* Maintain effective working relationships with FAA and EASA representatives and other applicable regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely notification, investigation, and resolution of reportable quality and regulatory issues.
  

**Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

  

* Establish and maintain an effective internal audit program covering production, repair station operations, suppliers, and supporting business functions.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of nonconformances and audit findings.
* Establish and maintain an effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) process, including root cause analysis and verification of corrective action effectiveness.
* Monitor quality performance metrics, identify adverse trends, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate controls for material acceptance, inspection, product conformity, nonconforming material, configuration management, calibration, and quality records.
* Oversee supplier quality management and ensure appropriate qualification, monitoring, and corrective action processes.
* Drive a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance throughout the organization.
  

**Organizational Leadership and Executive Accountability**

  

* Report directly to the CEO/President and provide regular updates regarding regulatory compliance, quality performance, significant risks, and corrective action activities.
* Maintain independence from Manufacturing, Operations, and Repair Station production functions when performing quality oversight and compliance monitoring activities.
* Have authority to escalate significant quality and regulatory compliance concerns directly to executive leadership.
* Establish appropriate quality-related authority, including the ability to initiate product or maintenance holds and prevent release or return to service when applicable requirements have not been satisfied, consistent with approved procedures and delegated authority.
* Partner with functional leaders to ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization to ensure appropriate technical competency, staffing, and succession planning.
* Provide executive management with objective assessments of the effectiveness of the company's quality systems and regulatory compliance posture.
  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in defense or aerospace quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing a quality organization or regulatory compliance function.
* Demonstrated experience working within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing organization holding a Part 21 Production Approval.
* Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.
* Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence requirements.
* Demonstrated experience managing regulatory audits, responding to regulatory findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customer representatives.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.
* Demonstrated experience with root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action systems, supplier quality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical organizational procedures and controls.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate with executive leadership, regulatory authorities, customers, and employees at all organizational levels.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience overseeing multiple regulatory approvals or certifications within a single organization.
* Experience with both aerospace manufacturing and component repair/maintenance operations.
* Experience serving as or directly supporting a Part 21 Accountable Manager, FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, or EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager.
* Experience with AS9100/AS9110 certification audits and aerospace customer audits.
* Experience implementing and maintaining risk-based quality systems and safety management processes.
* Experience managing quality organizations across multiple facilities or operating locations.
  

**Leadership Attributes**

  

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Independence, integrity, and the willingness to address difficult quality and regulatory issues.
* The ability to influence executive leadership and operational management.
* Strong technical judgment and an understanding of aviation product safety and airworthiness.
* A proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing compliance issues rather than simply reacting to audit findings.
* The ability to balance regulatory requirements with practical business and operational considerations.
* A hands-on leadership style, with the willingness to engage in the details when necessary.
  

**Measures of Success**

  

Success in this position will be demonstrated by:

* Sustained compliance with FAA Part 21 Production Approval requirements.
* Continued compliance with FAA and EASA Part 145 Repair Station requirements.
* Successful completion of regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.
* Timely and effective resolution of audit findings and corrective actions.
* Effective quality system performance and reduction of recurring nonconformances.
* Strong organizational understanding of quality responsibilities and regulatory requirements.

Miltope Corporation is deeply committed to building a workplace community where inclusion is valued, and everyone feels welcomed.*** We are proud to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, family status, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status, or any other legally protected grounds. ***So, bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Plant Manager** to oversee and manage all aspects of multi-site plant operations, ensuring efficient production, high-quality standards, and a safe working environment.  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, proven experience in managing manufacturing plants, and a thorough understanding of operational strategies, including safety, budgeting, and human resource management. The Plant Manager will also be responsible for ensuring production goals are met, maintaining plant facilities, and continuously improving processes to maximize efficiency

### **How You Will Help**

  

* Lead and manage daily operations of the manufacturing plant to meet production schedules, ensure product quality, and achieve on-time delivery.
* Partner with EHS to ensure safety, health, and environmental regulations, including local, state, and federal safety standards.
* Develop and implement strategic plans for operational efficiency, resource allocation, and process improvements.
* Manage plant budgets and financial statements, ensuring cost-effective operations while meeting financial goals.
* Maintain and upgrade plant facilities and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition; oversee necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments.
* Monitor production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to optimize production processes and implement lean manufacturing principles.
* Create and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, leading by example and building strong relationships with team members.
* Implement and monitor inventory management strategies, ensuring proper material flow and minimizing waste.
* Develop, mentor, and manage staff, providing training and development opportunities to enhance skills and performance.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between departments to meet production targets and business objectives.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, making data-driven decisions to improve plant efficiency and productivity.
* Perform other duties as assigned by senior management
* Travel up to 10% domestically, including quarterly visits to company facilities in Pennsylvania and Texas to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

  

### **What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working in a custom manufacturing environment, including knowledge of assembly, fabrication, welding, and machining processes
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in plant operations, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, strategic planning, and financial statements.
* Strong leadership abilities with proven experience in team building, decision-making, and people management.
* In-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment, and safety standards.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, supply chain management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Certification or experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or supply chain management.

Bringing together more than 175 years of innovation, quality, and customer commitment under one name and one promise.

The company was forged in 1850, as American industry was being connected by pipe, valves, fittings, and the skilled people who knew how to put them in the right place. More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

In 1920, Reliable Automatic Sprinkler started doing one thing exceptionally well: building the fire safety systems that protect people and property. Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

The Plant Superintendent has a primary focus on driving, guiding and influencing the support mechanisms of streamlining and coordinating the overall operational effectiveness and efficiency of the assigned operations. The Plant Superintendent focuses specifically on: overall Health & Safety and Environmental compliance; quality control; maintenance and accuracy of all material inventories; coordination of inter-yard transportation of materials; ensuring volume quotas are being met by communicating with the Commercial Group; and Continuous Improvement for the facilities, administration, and management of Production and Maintenance Superintendents and Supervisors. The Plant Superintendent reports directly to the General Manager.

This position operates within flexible parameters. The primary goal of this position is to achieve excellence in all facets of facility management. Providing the highest quality product safely, effectively and efficiently decreases accidents and errors and increases profits.

**Essential Functions:**

Environmental and Health & Safety (H&S)

* Supports overall H&S issues within the facility by working closely with the Regional Safety Engineer(s). Ensures Environmental compliance in accordance with company, federal and state policies by working closely with the Regional Environmental Superintendent.
* Provides a safe environment for all employees, customers and visitors.
* Monitors H&S programs administered by MRB H&S department.
* Following an incident or accident, instructs personnel on Corrective Action Plans in accordance with policy.
* Monitors H&S and Environmental Compliance for all assigned locations to report any deficiencies and/or issues to the Regional General Superintendent, General Superintendent, H&S Engineer(s), and/or Environmental Superintendent.

Operational Performance & Best Management Practices

* Investigates to clarify, validate, test and analyze operational data for accuracy and validity.
* Oversees operations and maintenance in all departments.
* Reviews maintenance procedures and record keeping for all production equipment.
* Forecasts monthly production with Department Superintendents, in conjunction with the Commercial group, to ensure facility goals are met.
* Ensures that negotiated production levels are met and maintained for all departments.
* Assesses the effectiveness of transportation and other sub-contractors.
* Spearheads Continuous Improvement for the facility.

Equipment & Maintenance

* Monitors equipment needs and availability for the facility

Inventory & Quality Control

* Maintains communication with facility and regional Commercial and Transportation Departments to ensure material purchase quotas are being met for the facilities and material is being transferred or shipped in a timely fashion.
* Maintains accurate material inventories in all facilities, keeping in compliance with all internal and SOX controls, in conjunction with the regional financial group.
* Monitors assigned yard inventories.
* Ensures that reports of any off grade/ off spec materials are discussed with supervisor prior to shipment in order to eliminate quality consumer complaints, avoid downgrades, and eliminate claims
* Ensures all storage of finished goods is done in compliance with internal controls already set in place.
* Implements and maintains an effective, documented Quality Control program focusing on a strong relationship with Commercial and Sales departments.
* Works with internal and customer specs for materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

* Operates facilities within established Operating and CAPEX budgets and makes recommendations on a yearly basis for Capital Expenditures taking into account: equipment condition; environmental necessities; operational needs; ability to sustain business operations; business growth.

Administrative Management

* Identifies and spearheads any necessary training for all personnel.
* Ensures proper reporting is in place and being utilized for all production departments.
* Manages all personnel by setting up an appropriate management structure.
* Follows HR guidelines for status changes, salary changes, goal setting, annual reviews/evaluations, and payroll issues.

Special Projects

* Performs other special projects as assigned.

**Internal Control Responsibilities:**

Supports the Company’s Internal Control process which includes understanding, communicating and complying with defined internal controls as well as suggesting and making modifications to the policies, procedures and controls to better relate to the business.

Communicates upward problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, or other policy violations or illegal actions.

**Interpersonal Contacts:**

Internal contacts are by phone and in person with Metals Recycling Business personnel and various management level personnel. External contacts are by phone, e-mail and in person with potential and existing customers, other companies within the industry, and governmental agencies.

**Job Conditions:**

Workload is cyclical and can present significant time pressures when strict adherence to deadlines is critical. Workload is often reactive and cannot be anticipated or planned for. Often many extra hours are required, weekend, weekday and holidays. Exposure to physical operations at metal recycling yards; it is necessary to walk/climb in active industrial yards with uneven surfaces and to out-of-the-way areas.

Occasional exposure to inclement weather conditions and travel is required. Work pressure can be substantial during peak times, requiring considerable adaptability; disturbances of work flow, and/or irregularities in work schedule are expected and occur on an intermittent basis. Regular overtime is required. Offsite work involves meeting in person with current or potential customers, and visiting other Radius locations.

**Physical Activities Required to Perform Essential Functions:**

Ability to: sit or stand for extended periods of time, up to 6 hours per day. Position requires individual to: stand, walk, and/or otherwise move around a steel scrap yard environment. Some computer work is necessary requiring visual acuity to perform close detail work. Must have the ability to communicate in a professional manner by phone, e-mail and in person with all levels of internal personnel and business contacts.

**Qualifications:**

Minimum of 5-10 years previous experience in steel scrap yard operations, and familiarity with physical operations and personnel. College degree preferred; courses in business/operations management helpful. Project management experience or specialized knowledge a plus. This position requires possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive an automobile.

Knowledge of operations; leadership, analytical, organization, good communication, good mathematical skills; and intermediate computer competency. Ability to: apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of practical problems; deal with a large number of variables and determine a specific course of action.

**PLEASE NOTE: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.**

All U.S. applicants must be 18 years of age or older and all Canada applicants must be 16 years of age or older.
