Description:

**Come Join the Toledo Tool & Die Team!**

Located close to the Michigan/Ohio border, Toledo Tool and Die has diligently served the people of both of those great states since 1940. It was a company founded on one simple principle: to do the finest work possible for our clients and to deliver on every promise we make. Today Toledo Tool & Die has four facilities in the Toledo area and one in Pioneer, Ohio.

Toledo Tool & Die is looking for a **Plant Manager** to join our team to support our continued growth.

This is a full-time position based in Toledo, Ohio. We offer competitive wages, growth opportunities, and a clean, safe work environment.

**WHAT TOLEDO TOOL & DIE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Weekly pay
* 10 paid holidays
* 401k
* Full benefits

**WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT FOR THIS POSITION:**

* Previous experience at the plant manager level or equivalent
* Strong work ethic
* Positive attitude
* Consistent attendance
* Willingness to learn
* Safety minded

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and operational performance of an automotive manufacturing facility. This role ensures the plant meets or exceeds expectations for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. The Plant Manager provides strategic leadership to all plant functions—including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Materials, HR, and EHS—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements. This position plays a critical role in developing a high-performing culture, optimizing manufacturing processes, growing talent, and ensuring the long-term success and competitiveness of the facility.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production across robotic assembly, and related processes.
* Establish and execute plant strategies focused on safety performance, customer satisfaction, financial targets, operational efficiency, and workforce development.
* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams to drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with safety policies, regulatory requirements, and environmental standards while actively promoting a world-class safety culture.
* Oversee adherence to IATF 16949, ISO, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards; partner with Quality to address issues and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor and manage plant KPIs including OEE, scrap, uptime, throughput, labor efficiency, and cost performance; ensure action plans are in place to address underperformance.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment reliability, effective PM programs, and timely response to downtime or tooling issues.
* Oversee Materials/Logistics operations including inventory accuracy, material flow, scheduling, shipping, and customer delivery performance.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives, waste elimination efforts, standardized work implementation, and continuous improvement projects throughout the facility.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and visual factory standards across all production areas.
* Develop and manage annual plant budgets, capital expenditures, and long-term investment strategies.
* Collaborate with corporate leadership on production planning, capacity analysis, new program launches, engineering changes, and customer development initiatives.
* Ensure organizational compliance with HR, labor, ethics, and employment practices, including respect for human rights, non-discriminatory treatment, proper working hours, and wage law compliance.
* Build a positive employee relations environment through strong communication, coaching, and recognition; address workforce concerns and support effective engagement strategies.
* Lead regular plant meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective communication across all levels of the organization.
* Represent the facility with customers, suppliers, auditors, and corporate partners.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all environmental practices are in line with job scope / position. Examples include but not limited to: proper waste disposal practices, reporting of spills, non-compliance to permit, and addressing any improper practices.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all human resources, ethics, and labor policies and practices are carried out in accordance with company policy and as in line with the scope of the position. Examples include but are not limited to: respecting the human rights of all workers (prohibition of forced labor, no child labor, maintaining appropriate working hours, and non-discriminatory treatment of all workers), abiding by ethical standards such as zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, extortion, and embezzlement, maintaining appropriate working hours of employees along with ensuring compensation is paid to workers that complies with all applicable wage laws.
* Assumes additional duties as assigned, which may fall outside the primary scope of the role.

**ISO / ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS) RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure that the resources needed for the environmental management system are available.
* Communicate the importance of effective environmental management and of conforming to the environmental management system requirements.
* Ensure that the environmental management system achieves its intended outcomes.
* Direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the environmental management system.

Requirements:

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Industrial Technology, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive manufacturing experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role; automotive robotic assembly experience strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of managing large teams, complex manufacturing operations, and high-volume production environments.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of automotive quality systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO standards.
* Demonstrated success improving plant performance, reducing costs, and driving operational excellence.

**GENERAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire, influence, and motivate teams.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with employees at all levels, customers, and executive leadership.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
* Ability to build a culture of trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**SOFTWARE/COMPUTER SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with ERP or MES systems such as SAP, Oracle, Plex, QAD, or similar manufacturing platforms.
* Ability to interpret data dashboards, KPIs, and operational reports to guide decision-making.
* Demonstrated proficiency with digital tools used for production reporting, labor tracking, and quality management.

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager of Customer Quality
existing_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

**Other:**

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.
* Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Oversee the work of others.
* Assist with coordination of adherence to organizational goals, operating policies, and budgetary guidelines.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and provide solutions to complex problems based on established precedents and are consistent with organization objectives.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**  
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Hourly Rate Transparency:** $100,000- $180,000 annually

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* On-site gym
* Free electric car charging stations
* Potential for growth within organization
* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture

The PE Quality Control Head of Department (HOD) is responsible for leading the company's overall quality management function across internal manufacturing processes, suppliers, outsourcing partners, and OEM customers for MOBIS North America Electrified Powertrain, LLC. (MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.

* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Strategy & Operations**

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

**Remanufacturing & Refurbishment**

* Standardize machine inspection, teardown, repair, component replacement, testing, cosmetic restoration, and final acceptance.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

existing_roles.description:
**About Site**
--------------

Catalent’s Greendale, Indiana site is a key part of the company’s Wellness business, serving as one of North America’s primary gummy development and manufacturing centers. The site specializes in the formulation and production of traditional gelatin gummies and 100% plant‑based pectin gummies for nutritional supplements and nutraceutical applications, supporting a wide range of consumer health products. With strong in‑house R&D, quality laboratories, and flexible manufacturing and packaging capabilities, the Greendale operation partners closely with customers to develop innovative, high‑quality, and consumer‑friendly gummy delivery formats across a variety of flavors, shapes, and functional ingredients, all produced under rigorous quality and food‑safety standards.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We have an opportunity for a Senior Manager, Quality Systems to join our team and lead the Quality and Compliance functions at the Catalent Greendale site. This role oversees a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and release. The position ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations while driving continuous improvement across the Quality organization. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to maintain product integrity and ensure the consistent delivery of high‑quality products to our customers.

Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM  
Location: Greendale, IN  
100% Onsite

**The Role**
------------

* Oversee Quality and Compliance functions related to dietary supplement manufacturing at the Catalent Greendale site.
* Lead a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and product release.
* Review and approve manufacturing and packaging change controls, product formulations, label changes, deviations, corrective and preventive action plans, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, NSF, and SQF requirements for product manufacturing and participate in internal and external audits.
* Develop and maintain quality and compliance policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to product quality and oversee root cause analyses and corrective actions.
* Lead the Food Safety Team and ensure compliance with 21 CFR 110 and 117, HACCP Food Safety, and Food Defense Plans.
* Monitor the sanitary state of the facility and equipment to ensure cross‑contamination control.
* Collaborate with Operations to assess the effectiveness of sanitation programs and ensure compliance with food safety guidelines.
* Maintain a feedback loop with Customer Service to address quality issues affecting product release.
* Oversee training programs to educate staff on quality standards and compliance requirements.
* Establish and track key performance indicators to measure quality and compliance performance.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain teams to integrate quality into all production processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with regulatory agencies, external auditors, and internal stakeholders on quality and compliance matters.
* Oversee investigations, environmental monitoring, and critical control point incidents impacting product release.
* Support site management in enforcing current Good Manufacturing Practices and mentoring staff in compliance.
* Facilitate internal assessments, compliance meetings, and training sessions.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in science or related field (Chemistry, Microbiology, or Biology) and at least five years of pharmaceutical and dietary supplement quality experience.
* Minimum of seven years of related experience, including three to four years in a supervisory or management role.
* Experience in current Good Manufacturing Practice compliance and working in a quality role within the pharmaceutical or dietary supplement manufacturing industry.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines. The individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds; no lifting greater than 44.09 pounds without assistance. Must be accessible to the manufacturing floor and office staff and use required office equipment. Specific vision requirements include reading written documents and frequent use of a computer monitor.
* Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent‑sponsored leadership programs such as NGGL, GOLD, LEAD Now, GM Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

### **Preferred Skills & Background**

* Experience with investigation writing, including root cause analysis and report preparation for annual product reviews.
* Familiarity with regulations 21 CFR 111, 21 CFR 117, 21 CFR 211, GFSI, HACCP, Preventive Controls Qualified Individual, SQF, NSF, and UL certifications.
* Experience with electronic systems such as JDE, TrackWise, Electronic Document Management System, Learning Management System, Quality Management System, Veeva, Compliance Wire, and Stability Programs.

What makes a successful Quality team member at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit.

* Detail Oriented

* Courageous
* Collaborative
* Critical Thinker

**This is where** your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

**Your Role**

The Sr. Manager - Quality - Visual Inspection & Particulate Control provides strategic and technical Quality leadership for manufacturing and laboratory quality systems, with a focus on Visual Inspection and particulate matter control for injectable products. This role ensures that inspection programs, qualification/validation, particulate investigations, and associated controls are scientifically sound, risk-based, well documented, and aligned with regulatory requirements, compendial expectations, and the company Quality Management System.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Lead Quality oversight for manual, semi-automated, and automated visual inspection programs, ensuring inspection processes remain effective, compliant, and aligned with patient safety expectations.
* Develop and maintain risk-based particulate control strategies that strengthen defect prevention, improve manufacturing controls, and reduce product quality risks.
* Provide technical leadership for qualification and validation activities related to visual inspection systems, ensuring studies are scientifically sound, appropriately designed, and fully documented.
* Direct complex investigations involving visible particulate matter, inspection trends, and product quality events, driving objective root cause analysis and effective corrective actions.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Laboratory, and Quality teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, defect reduction, and continuous enhancement of inspection performance.
* Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and health authority interactions by providing expertise, documentation, and responses related to visual inspection and particulate control programs.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, trend analyses, and risk indicators to proactively identify emerging issues and ensure sustainable improvements.
  

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

  
  

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Typically 10+ years of progressive experience within pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, including significant Quality leadership responsibilities.
* Demonstrated expertise in visual inspection programs for injectable or sterile products, including inspection strategy, defect classification, qualification programs, and performance monitoring.
* Experience leading complex investigations, risk assessments, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs, validation activities, and regulatory inspection responses.
* Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and applicable compendial requirements, including USP <790> and USP <1790>.
* Experience making science-based quality decisions involving product disposition, compliance risk management, and quality system effectiveness.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills with the ability to build alignment across multiple functions while maintaining independent quality judgment.
* Leadership experience through direct people leadership, matrix leadership, or technical leadership roles.
  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Microbiology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting commercial sterile manufacturing operations for injectable pharmaceutical products.
* Expertise in particulate characterization techniques, defect identification, and contamination control strategies.
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives that improve inspection effectiveness, defect prevention, and process capability.
* Experience interacting directly with the FDA, Health Canada, EMA, or other global regulatory agencies.
* Certification or advanced training in Quality Risk Management, Lean Six Sigma, or related continuous improvement methodologies.

**Role Summary**

Parklane is opening a brand-new manufacturing facility in Michigan, and we are looking for a Plant Manager to work with us to build it from the ground up. As the senior leader on site, you will have accountability for the plant: safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and culture. You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Own the overall performance of the Michigan facility, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost
* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 3+ years in a plant management or senior site leadership role
* Proven experience leading a workforce of 100+ in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
* Experience launching, expanding, or transforming a facility is a strong asset
* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and quality systems (ISO 9001 exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of OSHA and workplace safety, environmental, and employment regulations in the U.S.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L awareness, and cost management
* Experience with ERP systems and data-driven performance management (D365 an asset)
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence across a matrixed organization
* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**About Parklane**

As one of North America’s leading providers of turnkey mechanical noise control and VIRS solutions, Parklane is on a constant search for top industry talent. Every day we help clients with their sound attenuation and vibration challenges. We do it by leveraging an agile approach to engineering, product manufacturing and implementation.

As an organization, we live and breathe our core values:

1. Challenge Accepted

2. Work Hard & Play Hard

3. Share the Wins & Own the Losses, and

4. Build Together, Grow Together

By sharing ideas and supporting each other at every turn, we’ve built a reputation both for service excellence and the strength of our workplace culture. Put simply, our team is committed to doing whatever it takes to help our customers succeed—and that’s why we need professionals with the experience and expertise to solve complex problems.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

existing_roles.title: Director of Operations
existing_roles.description:
GP Motor Company is an independent automotive dealership serving customers in Northern Utah. We offer a selection of pre-owned vehicles, including hail-discounted inventory, to help customers find more vehicle for their money. Our team works across sales, service, and vehicle operations to provide a straightforward and professional dealership experience.

**About the role**

The Director of Operations will oversee the day-to-day operating systems that support both dealerships. Reporting to ownership, this person will help keep operations consistent across locations, identify breakdowns, and lead practical improvements before they affect customers or dealership results.

This role works closely with dealership leadership, the Controller, and HR across store operations, back-office workflows, compliance, vendors, facilities, and reporting.

**What you'll do**

* **Oversee store operations:** Maintain consistent processes across both dealerships, including deal funding, title work, reconditioning, inventory movement, and vehicle storage.
* **Support cash and back-office workflows:** Partner with the Controller on daily cash management, cash-flow forecasting, accounts payable, and payroll preparation.
* **Manage compliance and audits:** Maintain dealership compliance with applicable MVED and state requirements; oversee audit readiness, deal-file standards, and corrective actions.
* **Coordinate people systems:** Work with HR on compensation plans, onboarding, training, and accountability systems for sales and support teams.
* **Manage vendors and facilities:** Oversee vendor relationships, leases, dealership lots, and shop operations. Lead facility projects and relocations as needed.
* **Build operational reporting:** Develop and maintain dashboards and regular reporting processes that give ownership a clear view of each store’s performance.
* **Lead projects and resolve escalations:** Coordinate cross-store initiatives, work with outside counsel and the CPA as needed, and help resolve customer escalations.
* **Identify and implement improvements:** Review processes, find gaps or inefficiencies, and work with the appropriate teams to put sustainable solutions in place.

**Qualifications**

* Experience leading operations, preferably in an automotive dealership or another multi-location business.
* Strong understanding of dealership workflows, including titles, deal funding, inventory, and reconditioning.
* Experience with operational compliance, audits, and process documentation.
* Ability to work effectively with accounting, HR, sales, service, and dealership leadership.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with KPIs, dashboards, or operational reporting.
* Sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple locations.

**Schedule & Work Environment**

* Full-time position with time divided between GP Motor Company in Kaysville and Parkline Motors in South Salt Lake. The schedule will be coordinated with ownership and may vary based on operational priorities at each location.
* This is an in-person, multi-site leadership role. The Director of Operations will regularly work at both dealership locations and collaborate with ownership, dealership leaders, and teams across sales, service, accounting, and HR. The role includes time in office areas as well as on dealership lots and in operational work areas.

**Compensation**

* The annual salary range is **$80,000–$95,000**, based on experience and qualifications.

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
80,000 - 95,000 USD per year(GP Motor Company)

existing_roles.description:
Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor – McDonald's

**Company:** Sidor Ventures LLC dba McDonald's  
**Location:** Seminole County, Florida (Sanford, Oviedo, Winter Springs)  
**Position:** Full-Time | Multi-Unit Restaurant Leadership  
**Compensation:** Competitive base salary, performance-based bonus opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, including health insurance and a 401(k) with employer match.

**About Sidor Ventures**

Sidor Ventures is a growing McDonald's franchise organization operating four restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida, and employing more than 200 team members.

We are building a high-performance organization centered on operational excellence, accountability, leadership development, and an exceptional customer experience.

As we continue expanding, we are seeking an exceptional, results-driven Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor to lead restaurant performance, develop our General Managers, and help drive the next phase of our organization's growth.

**This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a growing franchise organization, work directly with ownership, and help shape the future of the business.**

**Position Overview**

The Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the operational, financial, and people performance of multiple McDonald's restaurants.

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on leader who can develop high-performing General Managers, establish consistent operating standards, improve restaurant profitability, and build a strong leadership pipeline.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional operational knowledge with strong financial acumen, sound judgment, and a proven ability to lead through others.

This position works directly with ownership and will play a critical role in strengthening our existing restaurants while supporting future expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership and operational oversight across multiple McDonald's restaurants.
* Ensure consistent execution of McDonald's brand standards, Quality, Service, and Cleanliness (QSC).
* Drive measurable improvements in service times, order accuracy, customer satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits, operational assessments, and performance reviews.
* Identify operational challenges, develop corrective action plans, and ensure sustained improvement.
* Maintain strong food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance standards.
* Establish consistent operating procedures and accountability across the organization.

**Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Take ownership of restaurant-level financial performance, profitability, and controllable expenses.
* Analyze restaurant P&Ls, sales trends, guest counts, labor performance, food costs, and operational metrics.
* Partner with General Managers to develop accurate sales forecasts, labor schedules, and operating budgets.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales growth, operational efficiency, and restaurant profitability.
* Establish clear performance objectives and hold restaurant leadership accountable for results.
* Monitor inventory controls, waste, cash management, and other key financial processes.
* Develop and execute action plans to address underperforming restaurants.

**Leadership Development & Talent Management**

* Directly coach, mentor, and develop restaurant General Managers.
* Establish high expectations for leadership, accountability, communication, and operational execution.
* Identify and develop high-potential managers for future General Manager and multi-unit leadership positions.
* Partner with ownership on recruiting, succession planning, and organizational development.
* Build a strong leadership bench capable of supporting future restaurant acquisitions and new restaurant openings.
* Foster a positive, professional, results-oriented culture across the organization.
* Conduct regular GM performance evaluations and leadership development discussions.

**Strategic Execution & Accountability**

* Work directly with ownership to establish and execute organizational priorities.
* Lead regular business reviews with General Managers, using operational and financial data to drive decisions.
* Ensure timely follow-through on operational initiatives, performance improvement plans, and company standards.
* Proactively identify business risks and opportunities and recommend solutions.
* Support restaurant acquisitions, new restaurant openings, and organizational expansion.
* Maintain consistent, transparent communication with ownership regarding restaurant performance, personnel, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

**Qualifications - Required**

* Minimum 5 years of progressive restaurant leadership experience, including significant responsibility for high-volume restaurant operations.
* Demonstrated success leading General Managers or multiple restaurant management teams.
* Proven ability to improve operational performance, profitability, and leadership effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&Ls, labor management, food costs, forecasting, and financial controls.
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data, identify root causes, and implement effective action plans.
* Willingness to maintain a consistent, hands-on presence across restaurant locations.
* Ability to travel regularly between restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Current or previous McDonald's Area Supervisor, Operations Supervisor, or Director of Operations experience.
* Extensive McDonald's restaurant operations background, including General Manager experience.
* Hamburger University training and relevant McDonald's leadership development.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurants generating $3 million–$5 million or more in annual sales per location.
* Strong familiarity with McDonald's operating systems, operational metrics, and performance standards.
* Demonstrated success developing General Managers and building management succession pipelines.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings, acquisitions, or multi-unit organizational growth.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Sidor Ventures offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to attract, reward, and retain exceptional operational leaders.

Our benefits include:

* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Employer-sponsored health insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
* Paid time off
* Professional development and leadership training
* Significant opportunities for professional growth as the organization expands

Specific compensation and benefit details will be discussed during the recruiting process.

**Career Growth**

Sidor Ventures is focused on building a strong, scalable restaurant organization with a long-term commitment to growth.

We are seeking a leader who wants more than a traditional supervisory position. This individual will have the opportunity to help shape our operating culture, develop future leaders, and contribute directly to the organization's expansion.

As we grow, the scope of this position will have the potential to expand alongside the business.

**If you are an accomplished multi-unit restaurant leader who takes pride in developing exceptional teams, driving measurable results, and building a successful organization, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.**

*Sidor Ventures is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

existing_roles.title: General Manager, Data Operations
existing_roles.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As General Manager of Data Operations, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5–10 years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry’s classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

protected_roles.title: Vice President, Manufacturing
protected_roles.description:
**ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS COMPANY**

**Vice President, Manufacturing**

**Function:**

Operations & Manufacturing

**Reports To:**

Chief Operating Officer

**Location:**

Gilbert, AZ – On-site

**Clearance:**

Secret (or eligible)

**ABOUT ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS COMPANY**

Advanced Technology Systems Company designs and builds mission-critical systems that protect U.S. warfighters, national infrastructure, and allied partners. Our solutions are fielded by the Department of War (DOW) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), as well as the most demanding military end users in the world, where performance, quality, and on-time delivery are non-negotiable. As our backlog of multi-million-dollar government programs grows, we are investing in the people, automation, and facilities needed to deliver at scale.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a proven Vice President of Manufacturing to lead end-to-end manufacturing and materials operations across our government and defense program portfolio. This executive will provide strategic and operational leadership for production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, and material-flow functions—including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations—and oversee the manufacturing planning and procurement systems that enable execution. The role owns plant operations, factory overhead, process automation, throughput, process controls, and facilities, turning contract commitments into high-quality hardware delivered on schedule and within cost. This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who has scaled defense production and integrated manufacturing, quality, and supply functions to support sustained growth. You will sit on the senior operations leadership team and have a direct impact on program margins, customer confidence, and the company’s growth.

**ORGANIZATIONAL SCOPE**

The position is intended to provide executive-level oversight of the integrated functions and capabilities required to plan, source, build, inspect, and deliver products. Functions within the role’s organizational scope are expected to include hourly assembly and test personnel; manufacturing engineering; quality; procurement; and materials operations, including kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom management. The role also provides functional ownership and governance of the manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), in coordination with IT and Finance as appropriate.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Program Production Execution**

* **Contract delivery: Own manufacturing execution for multi-million-dollar DOW and government contracts, meeting cost, schedule, and quality requirements from LRIP through full-rate production.**
* Integrated planning: Lead integrated production and materials planning with Program Management, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain; align master production schedules, procurement plans, material availability, capacity plans, and Earned Value (EVMS) reporting.
* **Production readiness:** Lead design-for-manufacturability reviews, PRRs, and transition-to-production activities for new multi-million dollar programs.

**Plant Operations & Financial Performance**

* **Factory leadership:** Lead plant managers, production supervisors, manufacturing engineers, and hourly workforce across shifts; build a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Cost ownership:** Manage the manufacturing budget, labor, and factory overhead; drive cost-reduction initiatives that protect program margin and improve competitiveness on future bids.
* **Throughput:** Set and deliver targets for yield, cycle time, OEE, first-pass yield, and on-time delivery; remove bottlenecks and balance lines.

**Materials, Procurement & Quality**

**Procurement leadership:** Provide strategic oversight of procurement, supplier performance, sourcing, and material availability; align purchasing priorities with production schedules, program requirements, and cost objectives.

**Materials flow:** Oversee kitting, receiving, shipping, and storeroom operations to ensure accurate inventory control, timely material delivery to production, and effective control of work in process.

**Quality leadership:** Provide leadership and accountability for manufacturing quality, corrective and preventive action, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement; ensure quality is integrated into production planning and execution.

**Planning systems:** Own the business processes and functional requirements for manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems, including Costpoint MRP and Purchasing; drive data integrity, effective system utilization, and coordination with IT and Finance.

**Automation & Process Controls**

* **Automation strategy:** Define and execute a multi-year automation roadmap, including robotics, automated test, and MES/ERP integration, with clear ROI.
* Quality & process discipline: Lead the quality function and establish statistical process control, configuration management, corrective action, and documentation compliant with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, and customer quality clauses.
* **Lean & Six Sigma:** Deploy Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma practices to reduce variation, scrap, rework, and cost of poor quality.

**Facilities Management**

* **Facilities & capital:** Oversee facilities, maintenance, EHS, and secure-area requirements; lead capital planning, plant layout, and expansion projects to support backlog growth.
* **Compliance & audits:** Serve as the senior manufacturing representative for DCMA, customer, and third-party audits and source inspections.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership, including 7+ years at the director or VP level running plant operations for complex electromechanical, electronic, or aerospace hardware.
* Demonstrated record of scaling and automating production on large U.S. defense or military contracts, from low-rate initial production to full-rate output.
* Full P&L or cost-center accountability for factory operations, including labor, overhead, and capital budgets.
* Deep working knowledge of AS9100, ITAR, DFARS, CMMC, EVMS, and DCMA oversight.
* Hands-on experience implementing automation, robotics, MES, and data-driven process controls with measurable gains in throughput and quality.

Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing procurement, supplier performance, materials management, and production-support functions such as kitting, receiving, shipping, and inventory/storeroom operations.

Experience leading or optimizing manufacturing resource planning and procurement systems (e.g., Costpoint MRP and Purchasing), including cross-functional process and data governance.

* Proven ability to lead and develop large, multi-shift teams, including union or hourly workforces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* U.S. citizenship with an active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA or Master’s degree in Engineering or Operations Management.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
* Experience standing up a new production facility or greenfield line, and with contract manufacturer and key supplier negotiations.
* Background with prime contractors or fast-growing defense technology companies (e.g., unmanned systems, counter-UAS, C4ISR, or missile systems).

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* All active production programs deliver on schedule, with a clear plan to close any cost or schedule gaps.
* A funded, phased automation roadmap approved by leadership, with early wins in throughput and labor efficiency.
* Factory KPIs (OTD, FPY, OEE, cost per unit, safety) defined, visible, and trending up quarter over quarter.
* A strong leadership bench in place across production, manufacturing engineering, quality, procurement, materials operations, and facilities.
* Facilities and capacity plan aligned to the company’s three-year backlog and growth targets.

Production schedules supported by reliable material planning, supplier performance, inventory accuracy, and effective use of Costpoint MRP/Purchasing or applicable enterprise systems.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Mission:** Build the systems that protect U.S. service members and critical infrastructure.
* **Impact:** Shape a modern, automated factory and the operating model behind it, with the executive authority and investment to do it.
* **Growth:** Join a growing defense technology company with an expanding backlog of funded programs.
* **Rewards:** Competitive executive compensation, performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits.

*To conform to U.S. Government export regulations (ITAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Advanced Technology Systems Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

protected_roles.title: Director of Operations & Manufacturing Excellence
protected_roles.description:
Innovation, craftsmanship, and a customer-first mindset fuel our growth at Alloy Precision Technologies. Step into a role where your leadership elevates safety, quality, delivery, and cost—every day.

**A day in the role**
---------------------

Your morning begins with cross-functional huddles, aligning production, supply chain, maintenance, and planning on the day’s priorities. You review dashboards that track delivery promises, schedule adherence, inventory health, and quality metrics. Midday finds you on the floor diagnosing a throughput constraint, coaching leaders, and reinforcing safe work practices. In the afternoon, you refine the operating rhythm: standard work, real-time schedule visibility, and continuous improvement plans. You close the day mentoring team members and shaping the next wave of operational objectives that sharpen customer service and profitability.

**What you will lead**
----------------------

* End-to-end oversight of manufacturing operations, including production, supply chain, maintenance, production planning, and warehouse activities.
* Deployment of robust quality and efficiency standards that achieve performance targets and elevate product excellence.
* Ownership of safety leadership and environmental stewardship across all operations.
* Proactive resolution of production issues—investigating, analyzing, troubleshooting, and driving timely recovery plans.
* Design and implementation of on-time performance tracking to keep schedules visible and reliable, ensuring strong margins, responsive service, and consistent quality.
* Regular reporting on operational health, highlighting opportunities, risks, and results.
* Implementation of lean manufacturing and other flow/business process systems to reduce cost, improve quality, and increase profitability.
* Stronger cross-functional communication and collaboration with corporate teams and adjacent functions.
* Team building through mentoring, motivation, and effective delegation—empowering leaders to deliver results.
* Annual operating plans and programs that guide manufacturing, service, and distribution performance.
* Execution that meets or exceeds customer commitments and complies with AS9100 and all applicable regulations.
* Domestic and international travel as needed to support operations and customers.
* Additional assignments as directed by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

**Supervisory scope**
---------------------

* Direct supervision of group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; scope may evolve as the organization grows.
* Full-cycle people leadership aligned with APT policies and applicable laws: recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, work assignment, performance evaluation, recognition, corrective action, issue resolution, and career development.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience; background in precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is advantageous.
* Strong digital fluency: Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and developing labor standards for cost structures is a plus.
* High energy, results orientation, confidence, and strong interpersonal influence; able to build rapport at all levels.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; comfortable juggling multiple projects and customers in a fast-paced setting.
* Adaptable and resilient within a dynamic, evolving culture; passionate about excellence and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing required; Six Sigma experience is a plus.

protected_roles.description:
Description:

**Come Join the Toledo Tool & Die Team!**

Located close to the Michigan/Ohio border, Toledo Tool and Die has diligently served the people of both of those great states since 1940. It was a company founded on one simple principle: to do the finest work possible for our clients and to deliver on every promise we make. Today Toledo Tool & Die has four facilities in the Toledo area and one in Pioneer, Ohio.

Toledo Tool & Die is looking for a **Plant Manager** to join our team to support our continued growth.

This is a full-time position based in Toledo, Ohio. We offer competitive wages, growth opportunities, and a clean, safe work environment.

**WHAT TOLEDO TOOL & DIE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Weekly pay
* 10 paid holidays
* 401k
* Full benefits

**WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT FOR THIS POSITION:**

* Previous experience at the plant manager level or equivalent
* Strong work ethic
* Positive attitude
* Consistent attendance
* Willingness to learn
* Safety minded

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and operational performance of an automotive manufacturing facility. This role ensures the plant meets or exceeds expectations for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. The Plant Manager provides strategic leadership to all plant functions—including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Materials, HR, and EHS—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements. This position plays a critical role in developing a high-performing culture, optimizing manufacturing processes, growing talent, and ensuring the long-term success and competitiveness of the facility.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production across robotic assembly, and related processes.
* Establish and execute plant strategies focused on safety performance, customer satisfaction, financial targets, operational efficiency, and workforce development.
* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams to drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with safety policies, regulatory requirements, and environmental standards while actively promoting a world-class safety culture.
* Oversee adherence to IATF 16949, ISO, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards; partner with Quality to address issues and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor and manage plant KPIs including OEE, scrap, uptime, throughput, labor efficiency, and cost performance; ensure action plans are in place to address underperformance.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment reliability, effective PM programs, and timely response to downtime or tooling issues.
* Oversee Materials/Logistics operations including inventory accuracy, material flow, scheduling, shipping, and customer delivery performance.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives, waste elimination efforts, standardized work implementation, and continuous improvement projects throughout the facility.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and visual factory standards across all production areas.
* Develop and manage annual plant budgets, capital expenditures, and long-term investment strategies.
* Collaborate with corporate leadership on production planning, capacity analysis, new program launches, engineering changes, and customer development initiatives.
* Ensure organizational compliance with HR, labor, ethics, and employment practices, including respect for human rights, non-discriminatory treatment, proper working hours, and wage law compliance.
* Build a positive employee relations environment through strong communication, coaching, and recognition; address workforce concerns and support effective engagement strategies.
* Lead regular plant meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective communication across all levels of the organization.
* Represent the facility with customers, suppliers, auditors, and corporate partners.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all environmental practices are in line with job scope / position. Examples include but not limited to: proper waste disposal practices, reporting of spills, non-compliance to permit, and addressing any improper practices.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all human resources, ethics, and labor policies and practices are carried out in accordance with company policy and as in line with the scope of the position. Examples include but are not limited to: respecting the human rights of all workers (prohibition of forced labor, no child labor, maintaining appropriate working hours, and non-discriminatory treatment of all workers), abiding by ethical standards such as zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, extortion, and embezzlement, maintaining appropriate working hours of employees along with ensuring compensation is paid to workers that complies with all applicable wage laws.
* Assumes additional duties as assigned, which may fall outside the primary scope of the role.

**ISO / ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS) RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure that the resources needed for the environmental management system are available.
* Communicate the importance of effective environmental management and of conforming to the environmental management system requirements.
* Ensure that the environmental management system achieves its intended outcomes.
* Direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the environmental management system.

Requirements:

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Industrial Technology, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive manufacturing experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role; automotive robotic assembly experience strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of managing large teams, complex manufacturing operations, and high-volume production environments.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of automotive quality systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO standards.
* Demonstrated success improving plant performance, reducing costs, and driving operational excellence.

**GENERAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire, influence, and motivate teams.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with employees at all levels, customers, and executive leadership.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
* Ability to build a culture of trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**SOFTWARE/COMPUTER SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with ERP or MES systems such as SAP, Oracle, Plex, QAD, or similar manufacturing platforms.
* Ability to interpret data dashboards, KPIs, and operational reports to guide decision-making.
* Demonstrated proficiency with digital tools used for production reporting, labor tracking, and quality management.
