protected_roles.title: Senior Manager of Customer Quality
protected_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

**Other:**

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and provide solutions to complex problems based on established precedents and are consistent with organization objectives.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

protected_roles.description:
**About Site**
--------------

Catalent’s Greendale, Indiana site is a key part of the company’s Wellness business, serving as one of North America’s primary gummy development and manufacturing centers. The site specializes in the formulation and production of traditional gelatin gummies and 100% plant‑based pectin gummies for nutritional supplements and nutraceutical applications, supporting a wide range of consumer health products. With strong in‑house R&D, quality laboratories, and flexible manufacturing and packaging capabilities, the Greendale operation partners closely with customers to develop innovative, high‑quality, and consumer‑friendly gummy delivery formats across a variety of flavors, shapes, and functional ingredients, all produced under rigorous quality and food‑safety standards.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We have an opportunity for a Senior Manager, Quality Systems to join our team and lead the Quality and Compliance functions at the Catalent Greendale site. This role oversees a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and release. The position ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations while driving continuous improvement across the Quality organization. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to maintain product integrity and ensure the consistent delivery of high‑quality products to our customers.

Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM  
Location: Greendale, IN  
100% Onsite

**The Role**
------------

* Oversee Quality and Compliance functions related to dietary supplement manufacturing at the Catalent Greendale site.
* Lead a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and product release.
* Review and approve manufacturing and packaging change controls, product formulations, label changes, deviations, corrective and preventive action plans, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, NSF, and SQF requirements for product manufacturing and participate in internal and external audits.
* Develop and maintain quality and compliance policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to product quality and oversee root cause analyses and corrective actions.
* Lead the Food Safety Team and ensure compliance with 21 CFR 110 and 117, HACCP Food Safety, and Food Defense Plans.
* Monitor the sanitary state of the facility and equipment to ensure cross‑contamination control.
* Collaborate with Operations to assess the effectiveness of sanitation programs and ensure compliance with food safety guidelines.
* Maintain a feedback loop with Customer Service to address quality issues affecting product release.
* Oversee training programs to educate staff on quality standards and compliance requirements.
* Establish and track key performance indicators to measure quality and compliance performance.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain teams to integrate quality into all production processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with regulatory agencies, external auditors, and internal stakeholders on quality and compliance matters.
* Oversee investigations, environmental monitoring, and critical control point incidents impacting product release.
* Support site management in enforcing current Good Manufacturing Practices and mentoring staff in compliance.
* Facilitate internal assessments, compliance meetings, and training sessions.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in science or related field (Chemistry, Microbiology, or Biology) and at least five years of pharmaceutical and dietary supplement quality experience.
* Minimum of seven years of related experience, including three to four years in a supervisory or management role.
* Experience in current Good Manufacturing Practice compliance and working in a quality role within the pharmaceutical or dietary supplement manufacturing industry.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines. The individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds; no lifting greater than 44.09 pounds without assistance. Must be accessible to the manufacturing floor and office staff and use required office equipment. Specific vision requirements include reading written documents and frequent use of a computer monitor.
* Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent‑sponsored leadership programs such as NGGL, GOLD, LEAD Now, GM Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

### **Preferred Skills & Background**

* Experience with investigation writing, including root cause analysis and report preparation for annual product reviews.
* Familiarity with regulations 21 CFR 111, 21 CFR 117, 21 CFR 211, GFSI, HACCP, Preventive Controls Qualified Individual, SQF, NSF, and UL certifications.
* Experience with electronic systems such as JDE, TrackWise, Electronic Document Management System, Learning Management System, Quality Management System, Veeva, Compliance Wire, and Stability Programs.
* Experience communicating with FDA inspectors or other regulatory agents and handling FDA 483 responses.
* Experience using artificial intelligence tools to improve quality systems.

**Why You Should Join Catalent**
--------------------------------

* Positive and fast‑paced working environment focusing on continually improving processes to remain innovative and dynamic.
* Competitive Paid Time Off plus eight paid holidays.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day one of employment.
* Tuition Reimbursement – support to complete or earn a new degree.
* Site‑based Employee Engagement activities such as End‑of‑Summer and NFL kickoff celebrations, March Madness tournament, Summer Food Truck Fridays, Veterans Appreciation Lunch, Homemade Chili Cook‑off, Salsa Competition, Ice Cream Sundae Bar, and more.
* Employee Resource Groups focusing on Diversity and Inclusion.
* Environmentally friendly, community engagement green initiatives.
* Defined career path and annual performance review process with potential for career growth on an expanding team.
* WellHub program promoting overall physical and mental wellness.
* Perkspot offering exclusive discounts from over 900 merchants across various categories.

**Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career!** Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life-saving and life-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

personal initiative. dynamic pace. meaningful work.

Visit Catalent Careers to explore career opportunities.

Catalent is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.

If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, you may submit your request by sending an email, and confirming your request for an accommodation and include the job number, title and location to DisabilityAccommodations@catalent.com. This option is reserved for individuals who require accommodation due to a disability. Information received will be processed by a U.S. Catalent employee and then routed to a local recruiter who will provide assistance to ensure appropriate consideration in the application or hiring process.

California Job Seekers can find our California Job Applicant Notice HERE.

**Req #** 212920 **Location** Round Lake, Illinois, United States **Job Category** Quality **Date posted** 11/09/2026

  

**Overview**
------------

This is where you make a difference in our patients’ safety. As a member of the Baxter Quality team, you will play an essential part in our mission of saving and sustaining lives. Quality is important throughout the entire product lifecycle and works collaboratively with all areas of the organization. Because Quality touches everything Baxter does, a role in Quality provides many opportunities for growth, learning and a successful career that has a daily impact on people’s lives.

* Support for Parents
* Continuing Education/ Professional Development
* Employee Health & Well-Being Benefits
* Paid Time Off
* 2 Days a Year to Volunteer

**Success Profile**
-------------------

What makes a successful Quality team member at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit.

* Detail Oriented
* Continuous Learner
* Courageous
* Collaborative
* Critical Thinker
* Influential

  

**This is where** your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

**Your Role**

The Sr. Manager - Quality - Visual Inspection & Particulate Control provides strategic and technical Quality leadership for manufacturing and laboratory quality systems, with a focus on Visual Inspection and particulate matter control for injectable products. This role ensures that inspection programs, qualification/validation, particulate investigations, and associated controls are scientifically sound, risk-based, well documented, and aligned with regulatory requirements, compendial expectations, and the company Quality Management System.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Lead Quality oversight for manual, semi-automated, and automated visual inspection programs, ensuring inspection processes remain effective, compliant, and aligned with patient safety expectations.
* Develop and maintain risk-based particulate control strategies that strengthen defect prevention, improve manufacturing controls, and reduce product quality risks.
* Provide technical leadership for qualification and validation activities related to visual inspection systems, ensuring studies are scientifically sound, appropriately designed, and fully documented.
* Direct complex investigations involving visible particulate matter, inspection trends, and product quality events, driving objective root cause analysis and effective corrective actions.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Laboratory, and Quality teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, defect reduction, and continuous enhancement of inspection performance.
* Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and health authority interactions by providing expertise, documentation, and responses related to visual inspection and particulate control programs.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, trend analyses, and risk indicators to proactively identify emerging issues and ensure sustainable improvements.
  

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

  
  

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Typically 10+ years of progressive experience within pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, including significant Quality leadership responsibilities.
* Demonstrated expertise in visual inspection programs for injectable or sterile products, including inspection strategy, defect classification, qualification programs, and performance monitoring.
* Experience leading complex investigations, risk assessments, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs, validation activities, and regulatory inspection responses.
* Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and applicable compendial requirements, including USP <790> and USP <1790>.
* Experience making science-based quality decisions involving product disposition, compliance risk management, and quality system effectiveness.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills with the ability to build alignment across multiple functions while maintaining independent quality judgment.
* Leadership experience through direct people leadership, matrix leadership, or technical leadership roles.
  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Microbiology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting commercial sterile manufacturing operations for injectable pharmaceutical products.
* Expertise in particulate characterization techniques, defect identification, and contamination control strategies.
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives that improve inspection effectiveness, defect prevention, and process capability.
* Experience interacting directly with the FDA, Health Canada, EMA, or other global regulatory agencies.
* Certification or advanced training in Quality Risk Management, Lean Six Sigma, or related continuous improvement methodologies.
  

  

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $136,000 - $187,000 annually. The estimated salary is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

  
  

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

**US Benefits at Baxter (except for Puerto Rico)**

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Baxter US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits | Baxter

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal

**Reasonable Accommodations**
  
  
Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

**Recruitment Fraud Notice**
  
  
Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

The Plant Manager will work to continuously improve the organization as well as standardize where possible with other facilities in the appliance business. Additionally, this role collaborates closely with Product Management, Technology, Sourcing, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Central Quality to develop and execute NPI (new product introduction) strategies.

USA, Camden, SC

The Senior Director - Plant Manager executes the business strategy focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale of the Camden, South Carolina water heater plant. * Background and demonstrated technical depth in assembly operations and metal fabrication
* Demonstrated ability to drive change and cultural transformation
